cases.name: Delilah "Susie" McKee
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Susie was only a mother, grandmother, and a sister, she was also a hero. Susie was the youngest of 6 siblings and she was a strong and independent women. She loved her family and friends very much. She loved laying around in the house in her favorite pajamas watching movies with her children, and especially her three beautiful granddaughters. She enjoyed cookouts, listening to music and dancing. Susie was truly the life of the party, you always seen her with a smile on her face. She also is breast cancer survivor. She will be missed by her friends and family very much, but they all know she is their guardian angel watching over them."
cases.narrative: On 11/23/2019, she was found deceased on the bedroom floor. He had shot and killed her and committed suicide. Sheriff Mark Moon said the back door had been forced open.
